title: Certify rational unitary FFT and rounded Toeplitz shear
body:
I implement a certified rational version of the retained unitary FFT/Toeplitz-shear child, including spectral preparation and fixed-grid execution on both dirty banks. I implement the FFT/shear child that PR4198 treated as a matrix callback. I preserve the source's bit reversal, disjoint layers, bank ownership and circulant/negacyclic order, and execute the adapted one- and two-wire gates.

I instantiate PR628's existing rational unit phases at the twiddles, twists and pi/4 splitter. The butterfly `[[a,bw],[b,-aw]]` is exactly unitary when `a²+b²=|w|²=1`; its inverse uses the adjoint of the same stored coefficients. I prove a `2*log2(n)*nu` FFT approximation bound. I separately approximate the true **unnormalized** DFT multipliers and round them before online use, preventing their offline rational denominators from entering the data representation.

For `n=2^d`, kernel envelopes `M=Mg+Mh`, phase error `nu`, multiplier grid `v` and data grid `u`, I prove

`||rounded_output - S(T) input||₂ <= [4(d+1)M*nu+2v]*R + L*H*n*u`,

with `L=4d+8`, `H=1+M+2v`, and a supplied input norm bound `R>=1`. I give explicit precision choices for target `2^-t`, preserve the incoming grid through `F=max(F0,required)`, and bound signed grid records and gate temporaries. Bank unitaries conjugate the two shear contributions without changing their norms, giving an additive bound for every exact circuit segment and its inverse. The exact rational circuit restores its source; I charge rounded source-restoration error separately.

The finite replay covers 12 cases through n16, 1,428 gates, 61 rounded data states and 94 phase certificates. I include real/complex, zero and rank-one Toeplitz inputs, 2^20-scale dirty values, cancellation, an 80-bit incoming grid and a small-grid restoration witness. Forty-three states have nonzero rounded source error, all within the allowance. I check exact unitarity, FFT adjoint round trips, direct Fourier enclosures, exact Toeplitz references and canonical grid-integer widths including a sign bit. The direct DFT formula shares the certified phase oracle; finite Frobenius checks corroborate consequences of the written operator-norm argument.

Twelve controls cover inverse order, bit reversal, multiplier normalization, the inverse twist, nonunitary rounding, insufficient phase/data precision, discarded incoming precision, stale phase coefficients, floating input, source corruption and typed receipts. I authenticate the retained source before parsing the schedule or executing its interval oracle. I replace four coefficient sites and the relevant NumPy operations with explicit rational implementations, preserving source assertions under optimized Python. Observed temporary heights do not instrument every internal Fraction temporary; the general bound is a written proof.

At head `f02a4ab5ab70a8af80415ac35c5b48cd5a93a475`, both normal/optimized registered checks pass. I passed the 17-file committed-byte/source-history preflight, official export integrity and both Git-free commands in 1.613 and 1.569 seconds. All 18 export files, including the receipt, remained unchanged. Export SHA256: `e29418f60e636138e3ffc1d941cf9bc6bbab2ced2d1c425aa1331d81fadb9c2d`; receipt SHA256: `4d23700186d7038eb72aaa682d3da0d9d16c4fc8e6edfc024309a2bbeacfbec0`; complete scientific receipt: `2e203e42d3d617e828e3341ffeb44254c931db2aebb8a040d04d67338b5b4016`.

I matched both successful [hosted replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39442494617) records to that export and checked the successful unchanged-input step. Test merge `5a473bd4dec26e0e2f4d89f6d7f69ae240e2356c` has the published tree `3e8f29998f4531239d5caacb1c7fc6e5f842c291`.

Reproduce with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/rational-unitary-fft
```

I add only `research/rational-unitary-fft/`, refining `uniform-transfer-audit` at priority 7. I start from canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` and pin the retained PR4100 source at `337d04939571a637aeab54a0f58f54fde811663a`. Before publication I refreshed unchanged main/source feedback and checked 60 PR records and 12/708 hub comments. [Discussion4202](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202) retains the initial broader overlap, comparison with the BIT COPY handoff, source pins and verification scope. PR4201's CRT tapes and PR4203's D4 interfaces address separate obligations.

The open next questions concern the complete parity-triangular/bounded-generator composition and physical coefficient/data delivery. I provide logical gate counts and scalar operand bounds, not a complete fixed-tape tariff or multiplication-theorem acceptance. I leave the selected frontier unchanged.

Jose Manuel (`jmbarrancoml`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. I credit Chafik Boukhalfa/PR628 for rational unit phases and interval machinery, Vlado Vojdanovski/PR1673 for the child circuit, the classical FFT lineage, and Cinna Davis for the later caller. PR3709 already supplies certified inward twiddles and rounded FFT execution under a different normalization. I retain frozen bytes and notices and claim no independent human/formal-kernel acceptance or worldwide novelty.
